flagged.evidence: [F1] says that the skyscraper sheaf "has stalk $A$ at $x$ and stalk $0$ at every other point." Let $X=\{x,y\}$ have topology $\{\varnothing,\{x\},X\}$ and take nonzero $A$. The only open neighbourhood of $y$ is $X$, which contains $x$, so the definition gives $(i_{x,*}A)(X)=A$ and hence $(i_{x,*}A)_y=A$, not $0$. A $T_1$-type hypothesis, or a qualified stalk description, is needed.

Step 3.1 says the stalk formula "shows that $f^*$ is exact if and only if" tensoring at each stalk is exact on all $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}$-modules. Step 2.1 only treats stalk sequences arising from sequences of sheaves. For the converse, flatness quantifies over arbitrary stalk modules and needs a realization argument, for example applying exactness of $f^*$ to exact sequences of $\mathcal O_Y$-module skyscrapers at $f(x)$. That argument is not supplied or cited.
